title: Autonomous Kaggle search added 379,959 images with zero bounding boxes
symptom: Three large downloads succeeded and the log read '+379959 images (0 with bboxes)'.
root_cause: The pre-filter required agriculture vocabulary only, so 'plantvillage' passed on 'plant' + 'village'; classification sets entered the registry as detection candidates.
correction_made: Require an agriculture term AND a detection hint before download; reject zero-label downloads at registration (later softened into the needs_autolabel path).
